title: MarketingBrief
description: Input contract for the lm-marketing@1.0.0 Process Module. A MarketingBrief binds an audience, a goal, an allowed channel set, a key message, and optional constraints. Wave 10 extensibility proof: a package-local schema registered behind this opaque id by the ContractSchemaRegistry (Wave 2/3).

channels.description: Allowed channel set; the draft may only select from these.

keyMessage.description: Key message reproduced verbatim in the draft.
